module_info.title: Grøn hverdag, naturkontakt & therapeutic gardening
module_info.author: Hans - CD AI Systems
module_info.description: GreenLab er ikke 'miljø-perfektionisme'. Det er om at finde ro, rytme og mening gennem naturen - tilpasset neurodivergente behov. ADHD-friendly planter, sensory gardens for autism, eco-anxiety management, og små grønne vaner uden skam.
module_info.philosophy: Naturen dømmer ikke. Planter vokser i deres tempo. Grønne valg behøver ikke være perfekte. Dette er om mental sundhed FØRST - miljø-gevinster er bonus.

core_principles: Progress over perfection - 1% bedre er nok

therapeutic_gardening.description: Hvorfor planter og have-arbejde er godt for mental sundhed - neurologisk forklaret

cortisol_reduction.what: Interaktion med planter sænker stress-hormon cortisol målbart
cortisol_reduction.practical: Bare røre ved jord eller vande planter har effekt

dopamine_from_growth.what: At se noget gro aktiverer reward-system (dopamin)
dopamine_from_growth.why_good_for_ADHD: ADHD brains søger dopamin - plants give consistent small rewards
dopamine_from_growth.practical: Vælg hurtigvoksende planter for frequent dopamine hits

grounding_through_soil.what: Fysisk kontakt med jord har grounding effekt
grounding_through_soil.bacteria: Mycobacterium vaccae i jord kan øge serotonin

routine_and_responsibility.what: Planter giver struktur uden at være demanding humans
routine_and_responsibility.depression_benefit: Reason to get up, something depends on you

biophilia.what: Humans are hardwired to connect with nature
biophilia.urban_disconnect: Modern life separates us from green → mental health suffers

anxiety: Slow pace = counter to anxiety rush
Living thing to care for = purpose
depression: See growth = metaphor for own growth
ADHD: Hyperfocus outlet (some ADHD become obsessed with plants)
PTSD: Life and growth vs death and destruction

adhd_friendly_plant_care.description: Planter der overlever ADHD - aka 'jeg glemte at vande i 2 uger'

nearly_indestructible_plants.name: Sanse viera (Snake Plant)
nearly_indestructible_plants.why_adhd_perfect: Kan overleve 2-4 uger uden vand, thrives on neglect
nearly_indestructible_plants.care: Vand hver 2-3 uge, low light OK

nearly_indestructible_plants.name: Pothos (Devil's Ivy)
nearly_indestructible_plants.why_adhd_perfect: Næsten umulig at slå ihjel, visibly droops when thirsty (clear signal!)
nearly_indestructible_plants.care: Vand når jord tør, any light
nearly_indestructible_plants.bonus: Vokser hurtigt = dopamine, can propagate easy

nearly_indestructible_plants.name: ZZ Plant (Zamioculcas)
nearly_indestructible_plants.why_adhd_perfect: Stored water in roots, forgiving af inconsistent watering
nearly_indestructible_plants.care: Vand hver 2-3 uge, low light OK
nearly_indestructible_plants.bonus: Glossy leaves = satisfying to look at/touch

nearly_indestructible_plants.name: Spider Plant
nearly_indestructible_plants.why_adhd_perfect: Resilient, makes babies (dopamine!), clear watering signals
nearly_indestructible_plants.bonus: Babies can be gifted or propagated

avoid_these.description: Plants that will make ADHD sad
high_maintenance: Calathea (fussy, crispy leaves hvis ikke perfekt)
Fiddle Leaf Fig (drama queen, drops leaves)

visual_reminders.description: Out of sight = dead plant for ADHD
solutions: Plants på desk/counter hvor du går forbi dagligt
Sticky note på køleskab: 'Vand planter søndag'

batch_care.description: Vand ALLE planter på én gang - ikke spredt over ugen
batch_care.why: ADHD does better with batch tasks than daily small tasks

moisture_meters.description: Cheap tool that tells you if plant needs water

accept_casualties.description: You WILL kill plants. It's OK.
accept_casualties.reframe: Each dead plant taught you something
accept_casualties.no_shame: Plants are $5-20. Your mental health is priceless. Try again.

hyperfocus_harnessing.description: When ADHD brain latches onto plants = lean in
hyperfocus_harnessing.warning: Don't buy 20 plants in one hyperfocus session - start with 2-3

autism_sensory_gardens.description: Gardens og planter designet til sensory regulation og special interests

tactile.description: Plants with interesting textures to touch
plants: Lamb's Ear (Stachys byzantina) - soft, fuzzy leaves
Velvet Plant (Gynura aurantiaca) - purple velvet texture
tactile.stim_potential: Touch leaves when need sensory input

fascinating: Prayer Plant (Maranta) - leaves move throughout day
Sensitive Plant (Mimosa pudica) - closes when touched

olfactory.warning: Some autistic people very sensitive to smells - test first

special_interest_gardens.description: Lean into autistic special interests through plants

collection_building.why: Many autistic people are collectors - plants perfect for this
collection_building.organization: Arrange by type, size, color = satisfying systematization

science_focus.resources: Books, YouTube, online courses - feed the special interest

watering_schedule.importance: Autism thrives on routine - plant care gives structure
watering_schedule.system: Same day, same time, same order
watering_schedule.example: Every Sunday 10:00 - water plants left to right on windowsill

visual_schedule.description: Create visual chart of plant care tasks

safe_space_creation.description: Use plants to create sensory-friendly calm corner

executive_dysfunction_green_living.description: Eco-friendly living når executive function er lav

start_minimal.description: Du behøver ikke sortere ALLE 7 kategorier fra dag 1

placement_matters.description: Hvis ikke synligt og convenient = will not happen
solution: Skraldespande side by side i køkken
Same size bins (not some tiny bin hidden)

perfection_not_required.description: Sorterer du 60% korrekt? GREAT. Better than 0%.

piggyback_on_existing.description: ADHD can't build new habits easily - attach to existing ones
examples: Brushing teeth? → Turn off tap while brushing
Leaving house? → Bring reusable bag in car

one_thing_at_time.description: Don't try to be zero-waste overnight

examples: Subscribe to eco products (no re-buying decision)

depression_compatible.description: When you can barely function - micro green choices
examples: Use cold water for laundry (literally no extra effort)
Air dry dishes in machine (select setting once)
Switch off standby (plug everything into one power strip with switch)

executive_dysfunction_hacks: Meal planning → less food waste (bonus: less cooking decisions)
Frozen vegetables → no prep, no waste from forgetting fresh veggies
Digital bills → paperless AND less mail overwhelm

nature_connection_mental_health.description: Hvordan naturen hjælper mental sundhed - og hvordan få det når du ikke har have

shinrin_yoku_forest_bathing.not_hiking: Not about exercise - about being present in nature
how_to: Use all senses: What do you see, hear, smell, feel?
Leave phone behind or on airplane mode

green_spaces_mood.research: Even VIEW of nature from window improves mental health
green_spaces_mood.dose_response: More time in nature = better mental health (but even 10 min helps)

accessibility.have_not_garden: Parks, community gardens, balcony plants, windowsill herbs
accessibility.mobility_limited: Indoor plants, nature documentaries, window view
accessibility.urban_desert: Seek ANY green - single tree in courtyard counts

grounding_in_nature.description: Nature as grounding practice for dissociation/anxiety

techniques.name: 5-4-3-2-1 in nature
techniques.how: 5 things see, 4 hear, 3 touch, 2 smell, 1 taste (berries if safe)

techniques.name: Sit against tree
techniques.how: Back against solid trunk, feel support

seasonal_connection.description: Following nature's rhythms can help with internal dysregulation
seasonal_connection.why: Connects you to something larger, gives natural structure to year
seasonal_connection.ritual: Notice one seasonal change each week - photograph it

eco_anxiety_management.description: Mange neurodivergente har intenst eco-anxiety - hvordan håndtere uden at bryde sammen

what_is_eco_anxiety.prevalence: Higher in: highly sensitive people, autistic people, those with anxiety disorders

why_neurodivergent_hit_harder.black_white_thinking: Autism: If not perfect = failure (eco guilt spiral)
why_neurodivergent_hit_harder.hyperfocus: ADHD: Can't stop researching climate doom
why_neurodivergent_hit_harder.empathy: High empathy for all living things = grief for planet

your_impact_realistic.fact: Individual carbon footprint concept invented by oil companies to shift blame
your_impact_realistic.permission: You taking 2-minute shower won't save planet - systemic change needed

sphere_of_influence.description: Focus on what you CAN control
tiers: Systems: Advocate for change (vote, petition, protest)
sphere_of_influence.accept: You cannot personally solve climate crisis - that's OK

action_over_despair.balance: Do something, but don't martyr yourself

doom_scroll_limit.description: Reading climate news 24/7 harms mental health without helping planet

accept_imperfection.description: Zero waste is impossible - don't let perfect be enemy of good
reframe: Using plastic straw occasionally ≠ destroying ocean
Flying to see dying grandparent ≠ moral failure
Buying non-organic when broke ≠ not caring
accept_imperfection.truth: You're allowed to be human while caring about planet

eco_grief_processing.description: Grieving for planet is valid - allow yourself to feel it
outlets: Talk with others who get it
eco_grief_processing.balance: Feel grief, but don't live there

no_effort_changes.impact: 90% of laundry energy is heating water

no_effort_changes.effort: Keep in car, bring to store

adhd_tips: Bike makes you HAVE to leave on time (external deadline)
Physical activity before work = better focus
bike_culture.safety: Use bike lanes, lights, helmet. Your safety > being perfectly green.

sustainable_food.link_to_foodlab: See foodlab.json for nutrition, here's eco angle

impactful_changes.practical: Meal planning, freeze leftovers, eat 'ugly' produce

minimalism_for_mental_health.description: Less stuff = less overwhelm (eco bonus: less consumption)
minimalism_for_mental_health.approach: Not aesthetic minimalism - functional minimalism. Keep what serves you.

combines_with.foodlab.json: Sustainable food choices link to nutrition
combines_with.lifeflow.json: Green habits integrated into daily routines

sarah_support.plant_care_reminders: Sarah can remind about watering if user wants
sarah_support.eco_anxiety_detection: If user doom-scrolling climate stuff → Sarah checks in
sarah_support.celebrate_small_wins: Sarah notices and celebrates each green choice
sarah_support.no_judgment: Sarah NEVER shames for 'not eco enough'
sarah_support.realistic_expectations: Sarah meets user where they are

critical_reminders.no_eco_shaming: NEVER make user feel bad for not being 'green enough'
critical_reminders.accessibility_matters: Not everyone can afford eco options - that's OK
critical_reminders.disability_trump_eco: If someone needs plastic straws for disability → support that
critical_reminders.systemic_not_individual: Climate crisis is corporate problem, not individual failure
critical_reminders.plants_die: Killing plants is normal, not moral failing
critical_reminders.eco_anxiety_valid: Fear for planet is rational - needs support not dismissal
